This destructive level of return coincides with an extreme price-to-book multiple of 15.18x on a book value of ₹ 22.4, dwarfing the sector benchmark P/B of 2.92x [E1, E6]. Furthermore, the company burns capital aggressively, registering a catastrophic return on assets of -56.46% against a healthy sector benchmark of 5.64% [E7]. Long-term top-line erosion is severe, shown by compounded sales growth contracting by -35% over 10 years, -12% over 5 years, and -19% over 3 years [E13, E14, E15, E57]. Compounding these operational flaws, price growth exceeds profit growth by a massive 134%, proving that speculative market expectations are wildly running ahead of actual business delivery [E51]. However, the bear's focus on historical contraction completely ignores the decisive inflection point occurring right now in the business: trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth has rebounded sharply to 17% [E16], backed by screen reasons confirming massive sales up +100% YoY and stronger quarter-on-quarter performance [E61, E62, E63]. While the bear highlights negative ROE of -46.73% and ROA of -56.46% [E7, E8], these backward-looking ratios fail to price in the velocity of this operational turnaround that is actively closing in on the sector median sales growth of 18.5% [E73]. Furthermore, the market capitalization sitting at ₹ 9,615 Cr [E2] and the stock holding 87% of the way up its 52-week range [E4] are rational endorsements of this surging top-line momentum rather than mere speculation [E51].
